summary: Join our comprehensive Voice of the Customer (VoC) Programs Training Course. Master techniques to capture customer feedback and improve your business strategy.
lede: A Voice of the Customer (VoC) program is a structured way to collect, analyze, and act on customer and stakeholder feedback. For managers and professionals responsible for customer, beneficiary, or stakeholder experience, this training covers mapping feedback touchpoints, choosing collection channels, and analyzing responses for themes and trends. Participants also learn to prioritize improvements and close the loop by responding to feedback and communicating resulting changes.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals who regularly engage with customers, beneficiaries, or stakeholders and must translate feedback into better decisions and services.
audience: Service delivery managers in public institutions
Customer experience (CX) and service quality professionals
Product managers and innovation leads using feedback
Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL) staff
modules: Foundations of Voice of the Customer Thinking
Mapping Customer Journeys and Feedback Touchpoints
Designing Effective VoC Frameworks and Governance
Feedback Channels, Tools, and Data Collection Methods
Analyzing VoC Data and Turning Feedback into Insight
Prioritizing Issues and Designing Improvement Actions
Closing the Loop with Customers and Stakeholders
VoC in Public Sector and NGO Contexts
Overcoming Biases and Pitfalls in Listening and Responding
Embedding VoC into Strategy, Culture, and Everyday Work
prerequisites: Prior experience in customer service, stakeholder engagement, or program management is recommended.
